description:
Notes, checklists and voice notes. Offline-first, synced on your own server. A fast, private notes app. Your notes live on your phone, and on your own server if you want one - never on ours. Open it and start writing. No account, no setup, no connection: everything is stored on the device first, so keepIT is instant and works offline. When you want the same notes on your other devices, run the free and open-source keepIT server and they sync in real time. You can start without one and connect a server later - your notes come with you.
  • Notes and checklists, with Markdown as you type
  • Voice notes - record one and play it back, straight from your list
  • Photos from your camera or gallery
  • Reminders that fire on time, offline and with the app closed
  • Colors, pins, lists, archive and search to keep it findable
  • Share a note with someone to view or edit (needs a server)
  • Home-screen widget, and text shared in from other apps
No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
